acknowledgement: Authenticated recipient may acknowledge only messages issued to this connection; duplicate recently successful acknowledgements are no-ops. Acknowledgement is adapter handoff, not human read or exactly-once display.
revocation: Deleting friendship or adding either-direction block removes pending messages in the same transaction. Already handed-off packets cannot be recalled.
capacity_and_expiry: Expired rows are removed before capacity evaluation and fetch. Expiration is sent_at + lifetime <= trusted current UTC seconds.
